name: Big One Brenda

intro.text: Ten thousand rides on the Big One, me. Front seat, hands up, every time. I've screamed at every speed there is.
They gave me a lifetime pass in 1999 to stop me queueing. Now let's see if you've got the stomach for a proper battle.

win: Ooh, that's better than the first drop. Go on, have a go on the Big One. Tell 'em Brenda sent you.
after: Seventy-four miles an hour, that drop. My hair's never recovered. Neither has my hairdresser.
